extName.message: Browser Profiles Authentication - Secure Profile Lock

extDescription.message: Password protection for all Browser Profiles. Locks your profile on every browser start — hashed password, 100% local, no tracking.

unlock_subtitle.message: Enter your password to unlock this browser profile.

err_wrong_attempts.message: Wrong password. Attempts left before cooldown: %s

cooldown.message: Too many attempts. Try again in %ss.

err_unreachable.message: Could not reach the extension. Try reloading this page.

footer_unlock.message: Your data never leaves this device

setup_subtitle.message: Set a password for this browser profile. It will be required every time the browser starts.

change_subtitle.message: Enter your current password, then choose a new one.

err_too_short.message: The password must be at least 8 characters long.

err_hint_equals.message: The hint must not be the password itself.

err_save_failed.message: Could not save the password. Please try again.

success_text.message: Your profile will lock automatically the next time the browser starts.

success_change_text.message: Your new password takes effect the next time the profile locks.

footer_setup.message: Password is hashed and stored only on this device

clear_on_lock_label.message: Clear browsing data when the profile locks

clear_on_lock_desc.message: When the profile locks (on browser start or manual lock), the selected data is erased. A locked profile then contains no browsing traces — even if the extension is removed. This affects your own data on this profile; use with care.

idle_lock_desc.message: Lock the profile after a period with no keyboard or mouse activity, in addition to locking on browser start.

permission_denied.message: Permission was not granted, so this option stays off.

options_footer.message: All settings are stored locally on this device.

whatsnew_intro.message: This update adds new privacy and convenience options. They are all optional — nothing changes until you turn them on.

whatsnew_f1_text.message: Optionally erase history, downloads and more whenever the profile locks — so a locked profile leaves no traces, even if the extension is removed.

whatsnew_f2_text.message: Optionally lock the profile after a chosen period of no activity.

whatsnew_f3_text.message: The interface now follows your browser language (English and Russian).
